info.desc: Slowdive is the self-titled fourth studio album from the iconic shoegaze band Slowdive. Being Slowdive's first release in 22 years, it was released on May 5th, 2017 with two singles "Star Roving" and "Sugar for the Pill" preceding it's release. The album received highly positive reviews and acclaim upon release and it was included in numerous yearly top album lists at the end of 2017. .

podcast.body: This self-titled album, released in 2017 after many years of silence, was considered "very good" and "very well-made and worked." Despite being an "old school" style that might be perceived as somewhat outdated by some, it contained "great songs." Some publications even recognized it as album of the year or a top-five album, although these instances were rare. "el disco monimo que era una pasada sí que es verdad que a lo mejor es el estilo de Slowdive que han pasado tantos años y tantos años como en silencio se ha quedado un poco atrás pero el disco era muy bueno."
